QuestInfo.name: A Student of the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: Now you're a member of the Resistance! To find out what a member of the Resistance does, ask #b#p2151004##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151004# says he can't send you on a mission until you reach at least #bLv. 14#k first. You can hunt to earn EXP to level up, but there is also an educational program available to Resistance members. Speak with #b#p2151010#, the Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #p2151010# and asked about the educational program for the Resistance.

0.0: So, you're ready for your first mission as a member of the Resistance. You get to go out and do...nothing! You aren't high enough level to be useful to us yet. It'd just put you in danger, and then we'd have to send someone to rescue you. You want to help out? Then get to #bLv. 14#k.

yes.0: Gain experience to level up. You can gain EXP by hunting monsters, but participating in the #bResistance Educational Program#k might be faster.
yes.1: #p2151010# is in charge of the Resistance Educational Program. You should talk with #b#p2151010##k at #b#m310010010##k.
yes.2: Then see you at the next training session. Looking forward to seeing your achievements as a member of the Resistance!

no.0: I can't give you a mission until you reach level 14 anyway. Wouldn't want you getting hurt out there. Train first, kid. Then fight.

1.0: We meet again. Congratulations on becoming a member of the Resistance! I've had my eye on you. I believe #p2151010# sensed potential in you when they sent you here.

npc.0: Have you not gone to see #b#p2151010##k yet? He's right over there in front of the Training Room entrance on the right. Go talk to him!
